oss.name: ResourceSpace
oss.classificationReason: Pinned documentation/licenses/resourcespace.txt is a custom BSD-3-Clause-style license with an additional restriction on using ResourceSpace in derived product/project names. Use, modification and redistribution are permitted; no commercial-use or hosting restriction appears. Exact identifier is LicenseRef-ResourceSpace-BSD-style, not unmodified BSD-3-Clause. The custom license is not listed in the OSI approved-license directory; osi=false means no verified formal OSI approval. Because OSI Definition section 4 permits different-name requirements, the naming clause alone is not evidence of non-open licensing. Conservatively retained U pending formal-license review, not S. Functionally the FAQ identifies support and cloud storage above 10GB as the only charges, with no software/user gate. GitHub is official development code; stable releases remain in SVN.
serviceLimitations: First-party free cloud limited to 10GB; larger hosted storage and support are paid services. Self-hosting has no per-user charge.

health.rsx: Shared authenticated analysis: overall 3.3/10; license detector NOASSERTION. GitHub release metrics incomplete: official releases remain in SVN.

oss.name: Phraseanet
oss.classificationReason: Current LICENSE includes GNU GPL version 3; official download and product pages explicitly include all application interfaces/functions and unlimited users. Hosting, installation, training and maintenance are services. Classification covers Phraseanet itself; separately promoted Parade front-office customization has not been verified as part of the GPL application. Current repository is active, not archived, with 4.1.25 released on the check date.
serviceLimitations: First-party SaaS, installation, configuration, training and maintenance are commercial services.

health.rsx: Shared authenticated analysis: overall 5.4/10; license detector NOASSERTION. Five releases in 90 days; three active maintainers; LICENSE independently confirms GPLv3.

alternatives.migrationNotes: Suitable for a searchable media library with structured/embedded metadata, faceted and thesaurus search, collection/document permissions, annotations, validation and web galleries. Plan asset and metadata export/import and rebuild taxonomy, access rules and workflows; existing approval history, SaaS integrations and branded portal behavior need separate validation. Phraseanet publishes an API and bulk import/export tools; no direct migration connector was verified. Parade is a separate front-office offering and its licensing is not established here.
